description: This file defines the PrismaBookingReportRepository class, implementing methods for managing booking report data via Prisma ORM, including creation, retrieval, updating, and filtering of reports, with specific focus on report linking, status updates, and querying by email or domain.

classes.name: PrismaBookingReportRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling booking report data operations using Prisma ORM.

methods.name: createReport
methods.description: Creates a new booking report record in the database.

methods.name: findAllReportedBookings
methods.description: Retrieves all reported bookings with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: findGroupedReportedBookings
methods.description: Retrieves grouped booking reports by booker email with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: findReportsByIds
methods.description: Fetches reports by their IDs, optionally filtered by organization.

methods.name: linkWatchlistToReport
methods.description: Associates a watchlist with a specific report.

methods.name: updateReportStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific report.

methods.name: bulkLinkWatchlistWithStatus
methods.description: Links multiple reports to watchlists and updates their status.

methods.name: bulkLinkGlobalWatchlistWithSystemStatus
methods.description: Links multiple reports to global watchlists and updates their system status.

methods.name: countPendingReports
methods.description: Counts pending reports for an organization.

methods.name: updateSystemReportStatus
methods.description: Updates the system status of a report.

methods.name: bulkUpdateSystemReportStatus
methods.description: Bulk updates system status for multiple reports.

methods.name: countSystemPendingReports
methods.description: Counts all reports with system status pending.

methods.name: dismissReportsByEmail
methods.description: Marks reports as dismissed by email for an organization.

methods.name: dismissSystemReportsByEmail
methods.description: Marks system reports as dismissed by email.

methods.name: findPendingReportsByEmail
methods.description: Finds pending reports associated with an email address.

methods.name: findPendingReportsByDomain
methods.description: Finds pending reports associated with a domain.

methods.name: findPendingSystemReportsByEmail
methods.description: Finds pending system reports by email.

methods.name: findPendingSystemReportsByDomain
methods.description: Finds pending system reports by domain.
